scope: AGGREGATE_ONLY — per-case actual returns are WRITTEN_TO_OWNER_CONTROLLED_STORAGE (474 records) and were not accessible. Every figure below is derived from published aggregates.

budget_under_test.secondary: <=2, same-dimension lower confidence, ONLY with explicit relation evidence
budget_under_test.supersedes: PRODUCT_CONTRACT_V1 section 3, which set 3 main + 5 secondary

THE_BINDING_CONSTRAINT.consequence: secondary requires explicit relation evidence, and no relation edge exists. Under strict-evidence mode secondary is structurally EMPTY for every record, not merely small.

Q1_main_empty_or_below_three.records_with_zero_direct: NOT_COMPUTABLE from aggregates; requires the private per-case returns
Q1_main_empty_or_below_three.finding: At least 60 of 79 records (75.9%) cannot fill main to 3 under strict evidence. The count that would return an empty main is not derivable from published aggregates.

Q2_metric_gap_change.interpretation: Pool shrinks from a mean of 6.53 named items to at most 1.92. Recall and NDCG are computed over that pool, so both will fall. That is expected and is not a regression: the removed items were the ones carrying no direct trace.
Q2_metric_gap_change.caution: Recomputing NDCG and recall under the strict pool requires the private per-case returns and was NOT done. The projection above is a bound on counts, not a measured metric.

Q3_explicit_expression_retention.reasoning: Explicit user expressions are exactly the DIRECT_DESCRIPTOR_TRACE set. Strict-evidence mode admits that set and removes everything else, so retention is preserved by construction.
Q3_explicit_expression_retention.finding: The strict budget loses no user-stated word. Everything it removes is material the user never stated and the system could not trace.

honest_assessment.positive: Strict mode retains 100% of user-stated words and removes only untraceable material. Under the new budget the system stops emitting specific descriptors it cannot license.
honest_assessment.negative: With relation edges at 0, secondary is permanently empty and 76% of records cannot fill main. The typical return becomes 1-2 named descriptors plus up to 3 directions.
honest_assessment.the_real_question: Whether a return of 1-2 named words plus directions is a product or an admission of insufficiency. That is a product judgement, not a metric one, and it has not been made.
